title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Found Rainbow Friends
moral: Friendship grows when you open your heart to someone new.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into a meadow full of animals. Bunnies hopped in the clover. Foxes played near the stream. In the middle of the meadow stood a small yellow robot. The robot sat alone and watched the animals play. A white unicorn grazed nearby.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked over to the robot. 'Why are you sitting alone?' asked {{NAME}}. 'The animals run away from me,' said the robot. 'They think I am scary.' {{NAME}} looked at the robot's kind face. 'You do not look scary to me,' said {{NAME}}.
